rv.q: Where Cumming has a puppyish enthusiasm – bounding out of a morose heartbreak soundtracked by Radiohead – Henderson is variously obstinate, contrary and funny. Hers is a fascinatingly unpredictable performance, not least when bending the rhythms of Williams’s songs: talk-singing one minute, soaring to melodic heights the next.
However, it’s a gentle, beautiful story with some cracking lines that the cast bring to life beautifully.
